title: What If You Dove Into Europa's Ocean?

scenes.text: What if you dove into Europa's ocean? It holds more water than all of Earth's.
Europa is a moon of Jupiter. Its ocean is thought to be 60 to 150 kilometers deep.
NASA says it holds more than twice as much water as all of Earth's oceans combined.
First you would have to get through an ice shell roughly 15 to 25 kilometers thick.
Up top, the air is so thin its pressure is about a hundred-billionth of Earth's.
NASA says Europa could have all the ingredients for life. That is why it built the Europa Clipper to study it.
